en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 9. And with the same chain of transmission, on the authority of Ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of `Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, on the authority of Sulayman ibn Khalid

that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) was asked to interpret the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: And that to your Lord is the end of all. He said: “If the statement ends with Allah, the Mighty and High, then abstain.”
